sources.title: PEP 354: Enumerations in Python
sources.sections_read: Rationale — Other designs considered: All in one class; Metaclass; Values related to other types; Hiding attributes
sources.confirmed: The alternatives distinguish an enumeration container from comparable values, a class-per-enumeration metaclass design, strong ties to ordinary integers/strings, and hiding keys/indices. A generic foreign enum class or code generator therefore is not automatically the same as either the all-in-one or metaclass alternative.
sources.limits: This verifies the frozen gold's intended scope; it is not a new baseline input and does not validate a Java/C++ design's implementation. The access timestamp is the recorded minute of the connector read.

sources.sections_read: Major features; Python objects in Lua; Threading; Restricting Lua access to Python objects
sources.confirmed: Lupa creates separate LuaRuntime objects; each runtime is locked against concurrent entry, and cross-runtime Lua values need copying through Python or explicit communication. The documented API therefore supplies more concrete boundary evidence than the separate Jep README candidate.

sources.title: OpenBSD 5.2 close(2)
sources.confirmed: FD_CLOEXEC causes a descriptor to close on successful execve; fork alone shares descriptor-referenced objects, and clearing the flag restores ordinary inheritance. This supports a descriptor-level policy across launch paths but is not an explicit Python default-policy proposal.
sources.limits: No claim that unmarked descriptors created by uncooperative native extensions are covered; non-atomic flag setting still needs a concurrency treatment.

sources.title: OpenBSD 5.3 open(2)
sources.sections_read: DESCRIPTION; O_CLOEXEC flag; ordinary descriptor inheritance default
sources.confirmed: O_CLOEXEC sets FD_CLOEXEC on a newly opened descriptor; ordinary open retains inheritance unless the requested flags change it. The candidate is a constructor mechanism and does not by itself specify whether Python's default is to change.
sources.limits: Open/openat does not cover every descriptor-producing API; cross-platform fallback and native-extension adoption remain conditions in the original response.
